name: Camper physical target and mounted relay regression
preparation: Run export_geometry.py against the existing approved Unity prefab and native camper-body mesh survey. Does not launch the game.
checks: Left/right shell, rear jamb, Travel hull and rear door bind the native E_Vehicle/CollisionCallForward contract even while inactive
Native binding preserves layer and enabled state and excludes seated player, wheels and special trigger colliders
Both actual camper skin intersections and outward normals
Both relay plate centers sit at vehicle-root Y2.345, the exact authored red-stripe midpoint (2.23..2.46), preserving battery Z alignment and native half scale
Native relay mounting plate seats two millimetres outside skin
Physical focus and wire focus pass the exact vehicle-root selection proxy
Real door, world wall and other vehicle occlude both focus paths
All 21 authored physical target IDs remain selectable in Camp
Hidden targets and Travel physical targets are refused
Fitted rear/front ladders admit native movement in Travel and Camp; bare pickup, transitions, hidden ladder and seated actor remain refused
Native relay plates share the existing station fade during Deploying/Packing, disappear in Travel, and expose wire endpoint triggers only in deployed Camp
Coincident door surface and interaction trigger remain selectable
limitations: Native/Unity object shapes and physics hit results are stubbed; production source algorithms are linked directly. Game wire edits, native electricity execution, save/reload and multiplayer are not simulated.
